If you are looking for high-quality custom plugins, OP SMP ideas, and powerful server features, this video is for you.

FIST PLUGIN – GOD ABILITIES SMP PLUGIN

The Fist Plugin adds a powerful and exciting spin-based system to your SMP, giving players god-level abilities right from their first join.

When a player joins the server for the first time, they unlock a special Spin System. This spin grants them one random Fist, each containing unique and overpowered abilities that completely change gameplay.

CORE FEATURES

• Spin system on first join  
• Automatic ability reward after spinning  
• 10 unique Fists with different god-level powers  
• Each Fist has custom mechanics and effects  
• Designed to be balanced for long-term SMP survival  
• Works perfectly on multiplayer servers  
• Ideal for content creators and custom SMPs  

HOW IT WORKS

On the first join, players can spin to receive their first Fist.  
Each Fist provides special abilities that make every player unique and powerful while keeping the SMP fun and competitive.

This plugin is perfect if you want to create a unique survival experience instead of a boring vanilla SMP.

COMMANDS

/fist  
Opens the Fist menu and allows players to view their abilities.

/fistadmin  
Admin command for managing Fists and spin settings.

SUPPORTED VERSIONS

Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.10

Make your SMP stand out with god-level powers, fair gameplay, and a unique spin system.
